snippet.title: Center Mass: Streets of Ramadi - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Step into the boots of an elite sniper and experience authentic modern combat in Center Mass: Streets of Ramadi!

Featuring real-world sniper mechanics, dynamic missions, cooperative gameplay, and authentic locations, Center Mass is a sniper shooter unlike any other. 

Wishlist today: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1948420/Center_Mass_Streets_of_Ramadi/
